name: The Warden
description: A steadfast protector who turns careful timing and borrowed strength into survival.
draftAbility: immediately after another player makes their first draft, you may choose a die from the pool as that player's second die. That player may accept or refuse it. If accepted, they take it immediately and are skipped during the second draft pass.

actions.name: Interpose ↻
actions.description: You become the target of the Entity's action if it targets a single player. Gain 1 Ward.

progressionActions.name: Hold the Line
progressionActions.description: Add 1 Ward, then deal 1 Damage if any Ward remains.

progressionActions.name: Unbroken Vow
progressionActions.description: Deal 2 Damage. If you are at 3 HP or less, deal +1 Damage.

progression.left: Once per entity, prevent 1 Damage to another player
progression.right: Heal actions may target two players
